text:
maya: FYI a customer triggered a huge mixed-dim embedding send (600 items, dims: 512/768/1024 mixed) and it caused a sustained ingress backlog for ~30s.
david: Oof. Any 413s or timeouts?
maya: Splitter returned a few 413s once the framed payload > max_bytes. runtime kept the TCP conn open and continuous-batching waited on it. Overall P99 spiked.
luis: Do we have an estimator for "embed-units" before accept? We should show an estimate and recommended split count.
console-pm: We only show raw bytes today. UX suggestion: preflight estimate on paste/upload in Console with suggested chunk count and an "auto-chunk in SDK" checkbox.
maya: Implementation idea: add endpoint /embeds/preflight that accepts dims header + compressed size and returns estimated_units and suggested_chunk_size. Return structured JSON: `{"estimated_units": 485, "suggested_chunk_size": 100}`
david: Preflight is fine, but perf-wise we need a cheap check in the ingress layer too. We'll add an early detector: if compressed_bytes > THRESHOLD && mixed_dims -> tag as heavy and either route to slowpath worker pool or reject with hint header.
luis: Route to slowpath buys us time but could saturate downstream. I prefer fast-reject with `X-Embed-Preflight-URL` and `X-Embed-Suggest-Chunks`. Clients can auto-split.
console-pm: For rollout: metrics-only for two weeks, opt-in autop-chunk for SDK users, then soft fast-reject for 10% tenants (and explicit Console banner), then global. Also include clear support docs and code snippets.
david: Telemetry: emit `preflight.estimated_units`, `ingress.heavy_flag`, `reject.reason`, `suggested_chunk_size`, `sdk.autochunk_used:true|false` and `post_retry_success`. Keep cardinality low.
telemetry-bot: new schema registered: embeds.preflight.v1 (fields: estimated_units, suggested_chunk_size, is_mixed_dims, compressed_bytes_bucket).
luis: Can the SDK tag retry batches with `X-Embed-Client-Chunked: true` so we can measure autop-chunk effect?
david: yes add that header and count conversions. Also add a dashboard: preflight->reject->retry_success funnel.
console-pm: I'll wire the UX: preflight modal, "Try auto-chunk" toggle, and a persistent help link. Copy: "Large mixed-dim requests are expensive. We recommend chunking to N items or using streaming embeddings."
maya: I'll spike the ingress detector PR and a small e2e test with gzip framing variations.
deploy-bot: deploy triggered: embeds-preflight v0.2 -> staging (sha: ff12ab).
david: tagging @eng-oncall for canary SLO watch when we flip soft-reject.
maya: plan set. I'll create tickets: ING-1122 (ingress detector), SDK-455 (autochunk opt-in), DOCS-88 (preflight guide).
